title: An axiomatic foundation for optimized certainty equivalents
abstract: arXiv:2611.22119v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Optimized Certainty Equivalents (OCEs) are an important class of risk measures for optimization and risk management that includes the Mean--Variance criterion, Expected Shortfall, the Entropic Risk Measure, and expectation. Despite their importance, economic axioms have not characterized OCEs. We propose a new axiom called Fair-Coin Compensation, which characterizes OCEs together with Strong Risk Aversion and Normalization. We interpret Fair-Coin Compensation through the fair assignment of two losses by a coin toss: transfers between two participants can remove the additional risk created by the random assignment. Adding further axioms yields sharper characterizations. Monotonicity yields standard OCEs; Positive Homogeneity, together with Prudence, yields Expected Shortfall; and Fair-Coin Independence yields the Entropic Risk Measure. translated_title: 优化确定性等价的公理化基础
translated_abstract: 优化确定性等价是一类重要的风险度量，广泛应用于优化与风险管理，涵盖了均值-方差准则、预期短缺、熵风险测度以及期望。尽管其重要性显著，此前尚无经济公理能够刻画OCEs。我们提出了一个名为“公平硬币补偿”的新公理，它与强风险厌恶和归一化共同刻画了OCEs。我们通过掷硬币对两个损失进行公平分配来诠释这一公理：参与者之间的转移支付可以消除随机分配所带来的额外风险。加入更多公理后可以得到更精确的刻画：单调性导出标准OCEs；正齐次性与谨慎性共同导出预期短缺；公平硬币独立性导出熵风险测度。我们还利用新颖的等均值随机化公理对均值-方差准则进行了公理化刻画
tldr: 本文提出“公平硬币补偿”新公理，结合强风险厌恶与归一化首次从经济公理角度刻画了优化确定性等价（OCEs），并通过附加公理进一步分别刻画了标准OCEs、预期短缺、熵风险测度及均值-方差准则。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel axiom, Fair-Coin Compensation, which together with Strong Risk Aversion and Normalization provides the first axiomatic characterization of Optimized Certainty Equivalents, with additional axioms yielding standard OCEs, Expected Shortfall, the Entropic Risk Measure, and the Mean–Variance criterion.
